description:
Enable WATCHLIST monitoring for one case. A 200 body can still mean it failed.

This changes the case's screening state. Media Check is not enabled.

case.description: Internal caseSystemId, or the exact external caseId. Not a person's name or a profile referenceId.

name: enable_ongoing_screening
title: Enable Ongoing Screening

description:
Generate MRZ lines without creating a case or recording a verification.

Issuing state and nationality come from get_reference_data nationalities. ICAO conformity
does not prove authenticity, ownership, or validity.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth as printed. Not in the future.

given_name.description: Given names as printed on the document.

last_name.description: Surname as printed on the document.

name: generate_passport_mrz
title: Generate Passport MRZ

description: Get information about the version of the Public API, a link to the documentation, and a date and time that can be used to verify the 'Date' header.
name: get_api_info

outputSchema.description: Auxiliary information about the Public API.

title: Get Api Info

description:
Get a saved case by its internal caseSystemId or its exact external caseId.

An internal id is tried first. Use the returned case_system_id with the other case tools.

case.description: Internal caseSystemId, or the exact external caseId. Not a person's name or a profile referenceId.

name: get_case
title: Get Case

description:
Read audit events for one case, newest first, including passport verification decisions.

This does not record an audit action.

case.description: Internal caseSystemId, or the exact external caseId. Not a person's name or a profile referenceId.

page_reference.description: next_page from the previous page. Keep the query and limit.

anyOf.description: Optional FIQL query. Without eventDate, LSEG returns the last seven days.

query.description: Optional FIQL query. Without eventDate, the last seven days.

name: get_case_audit_events
title: Get Case Audit Events

description: Translate an external caseId into the internal caseSystemId the other tools use.
name: get_case_reference
title: Get Case Reference

description:
Get paginated match facts by internal caseSystemId or exact external caseId.

reference_id identifies a profile. result_id identifies the match on this case.

case.description: Internal caseSystemId, or the exact external caseId. Not a person's name or a profile referenceId.

anyOf.description: Optional FIQL filter, such as matchStrength==EXACT.

expression.description: Optional FIQL filter, such as matchStrength==EXACT.

page_reference.description: next_page from the previous page. Keep the case, filter, and limit.

name: get_case_results
title: Get Case Results

description:
Get one group's case template and resolution toolkit.

Secondary field type ids and resolution ids are group-specific. Read them before screening
or resolving a match.

group_id.description: Group id from `list_groups`. It owns the case template.

name: get_group_settings
title: Get Group Settings

description:
Poll WATCHLIST monitoring updates. Defaults to the last 24 hours. LSEG keeps 30 days.

No updates returns an empty list. Reuse window.since, window.until, and the other criteria
with next_page. This does not acknowledge updates.

case.description: Internal caseSystemId or exact external caseId.

mode.description: FULL returns match detail. SUMMARY returns counts.

since.description: Timezone-aware timestamp. Reuse it when paging.

until.description: Timezone-aware timestamp. Reuse it when paging.

name: get_ogs_updates
title: Get Ongoing Screening Updates

description:
Get the World-Check record for a match: its names and categories.

Pass the match's referenceId, not its resultId.

reference_id.description: World-Check record referenceId from a screening match, not its resultId.

name: get_profile
title: Get Profile

description:
Look up country codes, passport nationalities, providers, case-search filters, or API info.

WATCHLIST nationality and residence use countries. Passport issuing state and nationality
use nationalities.

kind.description: countries for WATCHLIST ISO alpha-3 codes. nationalities for passport ICAO codes. providers, search_filters, or api_info.

name: get_reference_data
title: Get Reference Data

description: Check WATCHLIST and Passport Check progress without screening the case again.

case.description: Internal caseSystemId, or the exact external caseId. Not a person's name or a profile referenceId.

name: get_screening_status
title: Get Screening Status

description:
List saved cases in one group, newest first.

Pass next_page back as page_reference with the same group and limit.

group_id.description: Group id from `list_groups`. It owns the case template.

limit.description: Cases per page. LSEG allows 1 to 100.

page_reference.description: next_page from the previous page. Keep the same group and limit.

name: list_cases
title: List Cases

description:
List the LSEG groups this service account can screen in, including descendant groups.

Call it before screening, then pass a group id to `get_group_settings`.
name: list_groups
title: List Groups

description:
Create a Passport Check case and screen it synchronously, returning its MRZ.

This writes a case. It does not record a human document comparison. limit truncates
WATCHLIST matches only.

anyOf.description: Stable external caseId. An existing id is refused.

case_id.description: External caseId. Existing ids are refused.

date_time_value.description: Date value for a DATE field.

custom_fields.description: Custom fields from the group template.

group_id.description: Group id from `list_groups`. It owns the case template.

include_watchlist.description: Also screen the name against WATCHLIST.

name.description: Case name. Defaults to the given and last names.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth as printed. Not in the future.

given_name.description: Given names as printed on the document.

last_name.description: Surname as printed on the document.

date_time_value.description: Date value for a DATE field.

secondary_fields.description: Extra secondary fields. Passport fields do not fill WATCHLIST fields.

name: passport_check
title: Passport Check

description:
Rescreen a case by internal caseSystemId or external caseId without editing its fields.

WATCHLIST and Passport Check only. Media Check is unsupported.

case.description: Internal caseSystemId, or the exact external caseId. Not a person's name or a profile referenceId.

delta.description: True screens changes since the last run. False screens fully.

name: rescreen_case
title: Rescreen Case

description:
Record a WATCHLIST match decision only after a person approves the exact choice.

Decline, cancel, expiry, changed inputs, and a replayed approval save nothing.
Status, risk, and reason must be allowed together by the group's toolkit.

case.description: Internal caseSystemId, or the exact external caseId. Not a person's name or a profile referenceId.

note.description: Remark saved with the reviewer identity appended.

anyOf.description: Id or label from the group's resolution toolkit.

reason.description: Reason id or label. Required when the toolkit status says so.

risk.description: Id or label from the group's resolution toolkit.

status.description: Status id, label, or POSITIVE, FALSE, POSSIBLE, or UNSPECIFIED.

name: resolve_result
title: Resolve Result

description:
Create a persistent WATCHLIST case and screen it synchronously.

This writes a case. Repeated calls without case_id create new cases. An existing case_id is
refused, not rescreened. Matches are candidates, not confirmed identities.

anyOf.description: Stable external caseId. An existing id is refused.

case_id.description: External caseId. Existing ids are refused.

country_of_residence.description: Individual country of residence, ISO alpha-3.

date_time_value.description: Date value for a DATE field.

custom_fields.description: Custom fields by typeId from the group template.

group_id.description: Group id from `list_groups`. It owns the case template.

place_of_birth.description: Individual place of birth, ISO alpha-3.

date_time_value.description: Date value for a DATE field.

secondary_fields.description: Extra secondary fields by typeId from get_group_settings.

name: screen_entity
title: Screen Entity

description:
Search saved cases in one group with LSEG FIQL, for example query primaryName=="John Smith".

Use get_reference_data kind search_filters for the fields. Quote values that contain reserved
characters. EXACT is the mode for an exact caseId. The group filter is always added.

expression.description: Extra FIQL filter. The group filter is always added.

group_id.description: Group id from `list_groups`. It owns the case template.

limit.description: Cases per page. LSEG allows 1 to 100.

page_reference.description: next_page from the previous page. Keep every search criterion.

search_mode.description: DEFAULT, BEGINS_WITH, EXACT, or CONTAINS. EXACT matches a caseId.

name: search_cases
title: Search Cases

description:
Record a human comparison of the generated MRZ with the document, only after approval.

Decline, cancel, expiry, changed inputs, and a replayed approval save nothing.
A repeat verification requires rescreen_case first.

case.description: Internal caseSystemId, or the exact external caseId. Not a person's name or a profile referenceId.

mrz_matched.description: True when the generated MRZ matches the document. Not the approval.

note.description: Note saved with the reviewer identity appended.

name: verify_passport_check
title: Verify Passport Check
